extensions.name: Slack
extensions.description: Post the input to a Slack channel, with a bot token or an incoming webhook; the message id comes out so another can reply in thread.

extensions.name: Telegram
extensions.description: Send the input to a Telegram chat through a bot; the message id comes out so another can reply to it.

extensions.name: AI
extensions.description: Send the input to a model with a role to play, and put its answer on the output — chain two to make each one a step.

extensions.name: Base64
extensions.description: Base64 encode or decode, standard or URL-safe alphabet, padding optional.

extensions.name: Certificate
extensions.description: Make a self-signed X.509 certificate and the private key for it.

extensions.name: Certificate Request
extensions.description: Make a PKCS#10 signing request for a key, to send to a CA.

extensions.name: Certificate Authority
extensions.description: Issue a certificate from a signing request, signed by a CA key.

extensions.name: Revocation List
extensions.description: Publish a signed CRL of the certificates a CA has taken back.

extensions.name: Certificate Path
extensions.description: Check a certificate against what you trust: chain, dates, and revocation.

extensions.name: PKCS#7
extensions.description: Make a PKCS#7/CMS signature carrying the signer's certificate, or a .p7b bundle.

extensions.name: PKCS#12
extensions.description: Pack a private key and its certificate chain into a password-protected .p12.

extensions.name: Cipher
extensions.description: Symmetric and RSA encryption/decryption — AES, DES, DESede, Blowfish, RSA; GCM with additional authenticated data.

extensions.name: Hash
extensions.description: Message digest: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512.

extensions.name: HOTP
extensions.description: Counter-based one-time password (RFC 4226). Takes a raw or base32 secret.

extensions.name: JSON
extensions.description: Take one field out of a JSON document with a path, or re-format the whole thing.

extensions.name: JWT
extensions.description: Verify a JWT against a secret and split out its header, payload and signature.

extensions.name: Key Factory
extensions.description: Derive a key from a password (PBKDF2) or rebuild one from encoded key bytes.

extensions.name: Key Generator
extensions.description: Generate a symmetric key for AES, DES, Blowfish, HMAC and friends.

extensions.name: Key Pair Generator
extensions.description: Generate an RSA, DSA or EC key pair.

extensions.name: Key Store
extensions.description: Read a private key, certificate and public key out of a PKCS12 or JKS store.

extensions.name: MAC
extensions.description: Keyed message authentication code (HMAC) over the input.

extensions.name: MCP Tool
extensions.description: Call a tool on an external MCP server, or list the tools it offers.

extensions.name: Branch
extensions.description: Send the value one way or the other: the side not taken carries nothing, so what hangs off it does not run.

extensions.name: Merge
extensions.description: Join two inputs into one, with an optional separator.

extensions.name: Secure Random
extensions.description: Random bytes from a named SecureRandom algorithm.

extensions.name: Signature
extensions.description: Sign data or verify a signature — RSA, DSA, ECDSA.

extensions.name: Sleep
extensions.description: Pass the input through after a delay; useful for pacing a flow.

extensions.name: Slice
extensions.description: Take a byte range out of the input and pass the remainder on separately.

extensions.name: Split
extensions.description: Split the input on a separator into two outputs.

extensions.name: TOTP
extensions.description: Time-based one-time password (RFC 6238), with a configurable step and digit count.

extensions.name: QR Code
extensions.description: Encode the input as a QR code image, ready for the Image View.

extensions.name: ASN.1
extensions.description: Read DER — certificates, keys, PKCS — as a tree beside its bytes.

extensions.name: Image
extensions.description: Show a result as a picture, for processors that produce an image.
